name: Coherent (Resonant) Breathing
equipment: A quiet space, seated or lying down
instructions: Sit or lie down comfortably, letting your body settle and your jaw soften.
Inhale gently through your nose for a count of 5.
Exhale gently through your nose for a count of 5, with no pause held at either end.
Keep the pace steady — around 5-6 breaths per minute total, smoother and slower than a normal breath.
Continue for 5-10 minutes, letting each breath stay effortless and even.
